New York City is the most populous city in the United States [d1][d2][d4][d6][d8]. According to the US Census Bureau data cited by Statista, there were about 8.34 million people living in New York City as of July 2022 [d6]. Other sources place the figure slightly higher or lower depending on the year: PolitiFact lists New York at 8,550,405 [d8], NYC.gov records 8,491,079 [d5], and World Population Review estimates 8.1 million as of 2024 [d4]. Los Angeles (approximately 3.8 million) and Chicago (approximately 2.6 million) rank second and third, respectively [d2][d4].
